description.value: Cannoli King is an authentic Italian bakery-cafe in Port Coquitlam that has been handcrafting Sicilian cannoli and artisan baked goods from scratch since 1985. Founded by Sam Pero, the shop features a cannoli bar where shells are hand-rolled, deep-fried in-house, and filled fresh to order while you wait. In addition to the storefront, the operation runs a food truck called 'PIPER' that circulates at markets, the PNE, and Italian cultural events across the Lower Mainland.
